description: Source code for managing Hybrid Automatic Repeat reQuest (HARQ) processes in a cellular scheduler, including handling of NTN mode, timeouts, and per-UE HARQ entities.

classes.name: noop_harq_timeout_notifier
classes.description: A no-operation implementation of harq_timeout_notifier that does nothing on timeout events.

classes.name: base_ntn_harq_history
classes.description: Template class managing HARQ history for NTN mode, handling ACKs and timeouts.

classes.name: ntn_dl_harq_alloc_history
classes.description: Handles DL HARQ processes in NTN mode, allowing lookup of specific DL HARQ processes.

classes.name: ntn_ul_harq_alloc_history
classes.description: Handles UL HARQ processes in NTN mode, allowing lookup and summing of pending UL TBS.

classes.name: cell_harq_repository
classes.description: Manages HARQ processes for UEs, including allocation, deallocation, timeouts, and retries, supporting both UL and DL.

classes.name: cell_harq_manager
classes.description: Coordinates overall HARQ management for the cell, including adding/removing UEs, handling slot indications, and creating HARQ processes.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Handles slot indication updates, triggers timeout processing.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops HARQ processing, deallocates all HARQ processes.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a UE has HARQ processes allocated.

methods.name: pending_dl_retxs
methods.description: Returns list of pending DL HARQ retransmissions.

methods.name: pending_ul_retxs
methods.description: Returns list of pending UL HARQ retransmissions.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a new UE with specified number of UL and DL HARQ processes.

methods.name: destroy_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE and deallocates its HARQ processes.

methods.name: new_dl_tx
methods.description: Creates a new DL HARQ process for a UE.

methods.name: new_ul_tx
methods.description: Creates a new UL HARQ process for a UE.

methods.name: handle_harq_ack_timeout
methods.description: Handles timeout for HARQ processes, deallocating or reporting as needed.

methods.name: alloc_harq
methods.description: Allocates a HARQ process for a UE, setting parameters and adding to timeout wheel.

methods.name: dealloc_harq
methods.description: Deallocates a HARQ process, removing from lists and marking as free.

methods.name: handle_ack
methods.description: Processes ACK/NACK for a HARQ process, possibly deallocating or setting pending retransmission.

methods.name: set_pending_retx
methods.description: Marks a HARQ process as pending retransmission, updating timeout.

methods.name: handle_new_retx
methods.description: Handles request to retransmit a HARQ process.

methods.name: reserve_ue_harqs
methods.description: Reserves HARQ processes for a new UE.

methods.name: extend_ue_harqs
methods.description: Extends HARQ process list for a UE.

methods.name: destroy_ue
methods.description: Destroys HARQ processes for a UE.

methods.name: cancel_retxs
methods.description: Cancels retransmission requests for a HARQ process.

methods.name: find_ue_harq_in_state
methods.description: Finds a HARQ process for a UE in a specific state.

methods.name: is_ntn_harq_mode_b_enabled
methods.description: Checks if NTN mode B HARQ allocation history is enabled.
